description: Fetch practice exam questions for a CloudJobs study test (testId from list_practice_tests, e.g. "saac03"). Returns question text, multiple-choice options, documentation links, and the canonical quiz URL. Correct answers and explanations are omitted by default (includeAnswers: true to include them) so users are driven to take the interactive quiz on CloudJobs. Supports part ids like "saac03-2" and "saac03-bonus". Cite quizUrl when presenting questions.

includeAnswers.description: Include correctOption and explanation (default false - answers stay on the site quiz)

name: get_practice_questions
title: Get practice questions
